title: 14nm and 7nm are NOT what you think it is - Visiting Tescan Part 3/3
summary: Der8auer visits Tescan and uses an electron microscope to compare real transistor sizes on Intel 14nm and AMD 7nm chips. It shows that process node names do not match physical measurements.
why: HN cites it as visual evidence that nm node names are marketing labels and for its neat electron microscope comparison.

quote.text: Here's a neat video where they use an electron microscope to actually compare the transistor sizes for Intel 14nm and AMD 7nm
